# Nima Ghorbani

> Personal site of Nima Ghorbani, Head of Artificial Intelligence at Cubert Hyperspectral, Ulm,
> Germany. Computer vision, hyperspectral imaging, 3D human understanding and applied machine learning.

Sources of every page: https://github.com/nghorbani/nghorbani.github.io (Jekyll, al-folio theme).

## Pages
- [About](https://nghorbani.github.io/): bio and contact
- [CV](https://nghorbani.github.io/cv/): education, experience, invited talks
- [CV as PDF](https://nghorbani.github.io/assets/rendercv/rendercv_output/Nima_Ghorbani_CV.pdf)
- [Publications](https://nghorbani.github.io/publications/)
- [Blog](https://nghorbani.github.io/blog/)
- [News](https://nghorbani.github.io/news/)

## Publications
(keep in sync with _bibliography/papers.bib)
- 2024 The Poses for Equine Research Dataset (PFERD), Scientific Data: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03312-1
- 2021 SOMA: Solving Optical Marker-Based MoCap Automatically, ICCV: https://soma.is.tue.mpg.de/
- 2021 hSMAL: Detailed Horse Shape and Pose Reconstruction for Motion Pattern Recognition, CV4Animals workshop at CVPR: https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.10102
- 2020 GRAB: A Dataset of Whole-Body Human Grasping of Objects, ECCV: https://grab.is.tue.mpg.de/
- 2019 Expressive Body Capture: 3D Hands, Face, and Body from a Single Image (SMPL-X), CVPR: https://smpl-x.is.tue.mpg.de/
- 2019 AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes, ICCV: https://amass.is.tue.mpg.de/
- 2018 Spike-triggered average electrical stimuli as input filters for bionic vision, a perspective, Journal of Neural Engineering: https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1088/1741-2552/aae493
